name: LARPD year-round event and park volunteers
org: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District (LARPD)
what_you_do: Help at park district events like Sycamore Scares, the Halloween Boo Bash and holiday events, or join Open Space and native garden work days and the Neighborhood Park Ambassador program.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 and up, unless the event supervisor approves a younger volunteer ahead of time. Volunteers under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the online Youth Volunteer Waiver.
duration: One-time event shifts and recurring work days. The page does not set a minimum.
deadline_text: Sign up for each event or work day on its own. Upcoming listings include the Ho Ho Holiday Carnival (12/6) and Native Garden Work Days.
how_to_apply: Fill out the General Volunteer Application with a personal email (school emails do not work). Then log in to MyImpactPage, open the Opportunities tab and sign up for shifts.
notes: This is the year-round list. The separate Summer Youth Volunteer Program (ages 13 to 17) has its own card. Phone 925-373-5700. Office: 4444 East Ave, Livermore.
